drhp.business: The company distributes and supplies pharmaceutical, wellness and FMCG products, offering medicines (injections, tablets, capsules, ointments, suppositories, ophthalmic preparations, liquid oral formulations), vitamins, hormones, enzymes, wellness tonics, serums and diagnostic test kits, alongside FMCG personal care/toiletry items, ayurvedic products, cosmetics, food products, dental products and crude drugs. It serves pharmaceutical manufacturers, wholesalers, pharmacies, clinics and nursing homes through a single distribution platform.
drhp.expansion: The company acquired the running business of M/s. P.D. Doshi (a partnership firm) on a going-concern basis via Business Transfer Agreement dated April 1, 2024. Post the year-end, the Board approved (08-04-2026) acquisition of 100% stake in M/s. Siddharth Drugs Private Limited, a company engaged in distribution of drugs, medicine and related business/services, which is now a wholly-owned subsidiary.

market_size.metric: Organised retail share of India retail

sk.overview: India's organised retail comprises organised brick-and-mortar and e-commerce, with e-commerce the fastest-growing format. India retail was ~Rs 83 trillion in FY2025 (~21% organised) and is projected to reach Rs 123-135 trillion by FY2030. India e-commerce (including quick commerce) is ~Rs 6 trillion GMV (~US$70 billion) currently, projected to reach Rs 15-18 trillion (12-13% retail penetration) by FY2030. Within e-commerce two models have emerged: value-focused e-commerce (discovery-led, wide/affordable assortment, monetised via advertising and low commissions) and convenience-focused …

sk.structure: Unorganised retail accounts for ~79% of India retail (kirana/independent/family-run). Organised retail (~21% FY2025) spans organised brick-and-mortar and e-commerce.
